_comment: Admin panel shell: head, top bar, sidebar navigation, login gate. Owned by the admin-shell unit — not the ~20 admin sections' own screens.
admin.shell.meta.title: Appointment Administration
admin.shell.meta.description: Private panel to manage appointment requests, visits, doctors, centers and services for {{brand}}.
admin.shell.gate.title: Administrator access
admin.shell.gate.intro: Enter your username and password to see the request queue.
admin.shell.gate.intro_totp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
admin.shell.gate.btn_passkey: or sign in with a passkey
admin.shell.gate.help_forgot: Forgot your password? Ask administration to send you a new sign-in.
admin.shell.gate.err_turnstile_load: The anti-bot check couldn't load. Reload the page.
admin.shell.gate.err_controller_load: The sign-in screen couldn't load. Reload the page.
admin.shell.gate.err_turnstile: We couldn't verify you're not a bot. Try again.
admin.shell.gate.err_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
admin.shell.gate.err_passkey: Couldn't sign in with the passkey.
admin.shell.gate.err_no_access: Your account has no access to the panel.
admin.shell.gate.err_session_expired: Your session ended. Sign in again.
admin.shell.gate.err_session_unknown: We couldn't verify your session (connection problem). Reload the page.
admin.shell.gate.err_db: The system is temporarily offline. Wait a few minutes and try again.
admin.shell.toast.action_failed: The action didn't go through. Try again.
admin.shell.toast.demo_read_only: Read-only demo: this action is disabled. You can keep exploring every screen.
admin.shell.nudge_2fa.text: The panel will require two-step verification from {fecha}. Set it up before then so you don't lose access.
admin.shell.gate.portal_not_registered: Ask an administrator to add you with this email.
admin.shell.gate.portal_no_access_title: Your account has no access to the panel
admin.shell.gate.portal_unavailable: Try again in a few minutes. If it persists, tell the administration.
admin.shell.gate.portal_sign_in: Sign in with your portal account.
admin.shell.export.empty: There are no rows to download.
admin.shell.export.error.invalid: The file could not be built. Reload the page and download again.
admin.shell.export.error.screen: This screen is not downloadable: it is a large list. Filter it and download the part you need.
admin.shell.export.error.too_many: There are {n} rows and up to {max} can be downloaded. Pick a day, a doctor or a narrower filter and download again.
admin.shell.export.error.too_big: The table is too large to download. Pick a day, a doctor or a narrower filter.
admin.shell.export.error.forbidden: Your user cannot see this screen, so it cannot download it.
